vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: claude-max-proxy-setup
Version: 1.1.0

The skill is classified as suspicious due to its reliance on installing a global npm package (`npm install -g claude-max-api-proxy`) and setting up a persistent systemd user service in `SKILL.md`. While these actions are directly aligned with the stated purpose of running a local API proxy, they involve high-privilege operations that could be exploited if the external package were compromised (supply chain risk) or if the user ignored the explicit security warnings about exposing the proxy. There is no evidence of intentional malicious behavior within the provided files, and the documentation is transparent, even advising users to review the package source code.
